title: Not impressed
text: Not impressed. I bought this because I thought it would be better than the way that I was doing it and would get more juice out of the lemons and limes. After using it a couple of times now, I doubt that I’ll be using it much. Some seeds still got through and it doesn’t get anywhere near as much juice out of the lemons and limes as I was able to get doing it by hand. I’m still giving it three stars though because it does seem sturdy and others might have more luck with it than I have had.
